protocol: Fair grouped MobileNetV3 baseline: for each seed, build a case-level grouped SCIN split, train the image model only on that seed's training cases, export ONNX, and evaluate once on that seed's untouched validation cases.
validity_note: This artifact is the intended baseline for comparing Derm Foundation and decoupled-head experiments. It should replace fixed-model grouped diagnostics as the clean modeling comparison once all configured seeds finish.
